texts: The school works with the ecosystem through the panel. The parent works through a phone.
The moment a child passes the door, the arrival and departure times appear in the app. With the camera and the hours spent inside.
Monthly attendance, today's lessons, the teacher and the room number, all on one screen.
The mood curve and the per lesson attention are here too. Parents can see which subject their child is active in, and which one they fade in.
If smoking, a fight or a late arrival is detected, the notification arrives at once. With the camera frame, the confidence level, the time and the place.
And if there is more than one child, they all live in the same account.
